stem:
Chirag heats a pot of water from below.

What happens to the heated water?

options.text: It expands, becomes lighter, and rises; cooler water moves down to take its place.
It becomes heavier and sinks; cooler water rises.
It stays at the bottom, and the rest of the water heats with no movement.
It rises only after the water starts boiling and bubbles appear.

teacher.key_rationale: Heated water expands, becomes lighter, and rises; cooler water moves down to replace it.
